# Training cluster characterization


## Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(scabcd)
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(readr)

proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))

# Outcome data
cbcl_nausea_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_nausea_train.csv"))
cbcl_vomiting_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_vomiting_train.csv"))
cbcl_dizzy_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_dizzy_train.csv"))
cbcl_overtired_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_overtired_train.csv"))
cbcl_sleeping_more_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_sleeping_more_train.csv"))
cbcl_sleeping_less_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_sleeping_less_train.csv"))
cbcl_depress_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_depress_train.csv"))
cbcl_anxiety_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_anxiety_train.csv"))
cbcl_attention_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_attention_train.csv"))
cbcl_aggressive_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_aggressive_train.csv"))

# The SNF meta-clustering outcome rows we are interested in characterizing
top_om_rows <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_03_08_top_om_rows.csv"))
```

## Characterize CBCL measures

```{r}
cluster_df <- get_cluster_df(top_om_rows[2, ])


# Make a joined dataframe for further characterization
cluster_outcome_list <- list(
    cluster_df,
    cbcl_nausea_train,
    cbcl_vomiting_train,
    cbcl_dizzy_train,
    cbcl_overtired_train,
    cbcl_sleeping_more_train,
    cbcl_sleeping_less_train,
    cbcl_depress_train,
    cbcl_anxiety_train,
    cbcl_attention_train,
    cbcl_aggressive_train)
characterization_df <- merge_df_list(cluster_outcome_list)

# P-values
cbcl_ord_reg(characterization_df)

# Process 3: plotting


cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df, "cbcl_nausea")


# Process X: label propagation

a <- "cluster"


head(
     cluster_df |> dplyr::rename("clust" = !!a)
)

groups <- cluster_df$cluster
```
